{{Top|leg}}
'''Thermal detonator missiles''' were a type of [[Missile/Legends|missile]] installed on [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Each [[Hovertank/Legends|fighter tank]] was equipped with sixteen of the missiles.<ref name="RFT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040115tank|text=Republic Fighter Tank}}</ref>
